# Regex

A compiled regular expression: matching, finding, capturing, splitting and replacing, and escaping text to match it literally.

<h2 id="match"><code>Match</code></h2>

```rux
pub struct Match {
    pub start: uint;
    pub end: uint;
}
```

Where a match is in the text searched: from byte `start` up to byte `end`. `Copy`.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Regex/Src/Regex.rux#L37)

| ------- | ------ | ----------------------------------------------- |

| `end`   | `uint` | The byte offset just past the end of the match. |

<h2 id="regex"><code>Regex</code></h2>

```rux
pub struct Regex {
    // private fields
}
```

A compiled pattern. Not copied.
The syntax is RE2's: literals, `.`, classes such as `[a-z]`, `[^0-9]`, `[[:alpha:]]`, `\d`, `\w` and `\s`,
Unicode general categories and properties such as `\p{L}`, `\p{Lu}` and `\p{White_Space}`, the anchors `^`, `$`,
`\A`, `\z`, `\b` and `\B`, groups `(...)`, `(?:...)` and `(?<name>...)`, alternation `|`, the repetitions `*`,
`+`, `?` and `{n,m}` with a lazy `?` form of each, and the flags `i`, `m`, `s` and `x` as `(?i)` or `(?i:...)`.
Backreferences and lookaround are refused: without them every search takes time linear in the text.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Regex/Src/Regex.rux#L68)

<h3 id="find-at"><code>FindAt</code></h3>

```rux
pub func FindAt(
    self: &Regex,
    text: char8[..],
    start: uint
) -> Match? ! RegexError
```

The leftmost match in `text` at or after byte `start`. Anchors and word boundaries still see the text before
`start`, so `^` does not match there unless `start` is where a line starts.

| Name    | Type        | Description                                             |
| ------- | ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `text`  | `char8[..]` | the text to search                                      |
| `start` | `uint`      | the byte offset to search from, at a character boundary |

**Returns**: the match, or `none`

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Regex/Src/Regex.rux#L366)

<h3 id="find-all"><code>FindAll</code></h3>

```rux
pub func FindAll(
    self: &Regex,
    text: char8[..]
) -> MatchIterator ! RegexError
```

Every match in `text`, leftmost first and never overlapping. An empty match right after another match is
skipped, so `a*` finds three matches in `baab`: before the `b`, `aa`, and at the end.

| Name   | Type        | Description                                         |
| ------ | ----------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `text` | `char8[..]` | the text to search, which must outlive the iterator |

**Returns**: the matches in turn

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Regex/Src/Regex.rux#L410)

<h3 id="replace"><code>Replace</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Replace(
    self: &Regex,
    allocator: Allocator,
    text: char8[..],
    replacement: char8[..]
) -> String ! RegexError
```

`text` with every match replaced by `replacement`, in which `$1` or `${1}` stands for what group 1 matched,
`$name` or `${name}` for what the group called `name` matched, `$0` for the whole match, and `$$` for `$`. A
group that did not match, or does not exist, stands for nothing.

| Name          | Type        | Description                |
| ------------- | ----------- | -------------------------- |
| `allocator`   | `Allocator` | what the result is kept in |
| `text`        | `char8[..]` | the text to search         |
| `replacement` | `char8[..]` | what each match becomes    |

**Returns**: the new text

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Regex/Src/Regex.rux#L430)

<h2 id="match-iterator"><code>MatchIterator</code></h2>

```rux
pub struct MatchIterator {
    // private fields
}
```

The matches of a pattern in a text, one after another, leftmost first and never overlapping. Not copied.
Borrows the regex and the text, which must outlive it.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Regex/Src/Regex.rux#L159)

<h2 id="captures"><code>Captures</code></h2>

```rux
pub struct Captures {
    // private fields
}
```

The groups of one match: where each matched, or that it did not. Not copied.
Borrows the regex it came from for the group names, so it must not outlive the regex.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Regex/Src/Regex.rux#L205)

<h2 id="escape"><code>Escape</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Escape(
    allocator: Allocator,
    text: char8[..]

```

`text` with every character a pattern gives a meaning to escaped, so that the result, as a pattern, matches
